invite.title: Invite a colleague
invite.hint: The invite link is valid for 7 days and works once. Inviting the same email again replaces the previous link.

notices.roleChanged: Role changed. It applies from the member's next action.
notices.deactivated: Member deactivated. They can no longer log in.
notices.revoked: Invite withdrawn; its link no longer works.

errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: That email already belongs to a member of your agency.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please check the email and role.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many changes. Please wait a minute and try again.
